incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=network-lb-eu-west — symptom=TLS handshake failures; urgency=high; incident_id=INC-20260314-1145

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260314-1145 — responders: alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): Acked and joining. seeing initial alerts for increase in TLS handshakes failing (~15% error rate).

ben (net-eng): I'm seeing the same from the ALB metrics — TargetGroup: inference-eu-w-01, Unhealthy hosts rising from 0 -> 3 in last 4m. TLS errors look like: "alert: SSL_do_handshake() failed - error:1408A0C1:SSL routines:ssl3_get_client_hello:no shared cipher"

sresteve: Logs from edge-proxy eu-west-1 showing repeated "tlsv1 alert internal error" and 503s. Pasting last minute from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-14T11:44:12Z edge-proxy[awslb] connection from 10.2.11.34: TLS handshake error: no cipher match
2026-03-14T11:44:13Z healthchecker target inference-backend-3 UNHEALTHY: 502
2026-03-14T11:44:14Z edge-proxy[awslb] connection from 10.2.12.78: TLS alert (internal error)
```

dana (platform): Any recent cert rotations or security policy updates? I don't see automated cert renewals for eu-west scheduled today. No rollout in infra-change log in last 24h.

ben (net-eng): Checking ALB TLS policy — it still has TLS1.2+ and strong ciphers. Could be client-side negotiation failure with some old clients, but error rate is across many client IPs so likely backend. Running curl to backend host over our VPC: `curl -v https://10.2.11.34:8443` returns handshake failure too.

alice (oncall): Impact estimate from metrics: ~12% of GET/text-generation requests in eu-west are failing to handshake; latency for succeeding requests up ~30%. A few enterprise customers reported errors via support. Marking P1.

support-lead: Support queue shows 7 customers opening tickets in the last 10 mins; severity varied. Notifying account owners for high-value customers.

ben (net-eng): Looking at backend JVMs — recent GC churn? backend logs show repeated "SSLHandshakeException: Received fatal alert: handshake_failure". However cert chain present. I'm going to run `openssl s_client -connect 10.2.11.34:8443 -tlsextdebug -status` to see server hello.

auto-ops-bot: Auto-remediation attempted: drained target inference-backend-3 from LB, routed traffic to other targets. 2m ago.

sresteve: After drain, error rate dropped from 15% -> 8% but still elevated. One remaining target shows intermittent tls errors.

dana (platform): Initiating controlled failover: shifting 50% traffic from eu-west to eu-central for inference-edge endpoints. Updating routing policy now (canary shift). TTLs: do NOT change DNS TTL — using routing weight approach.

alice (oncall): Good. Inform customers via status page. @support-lead can you post an initial status update that we're investigating and partially mitigating by shifting traffic?

support-lead: Posting now to status.redwood.ai — note: "Degraded: TLS handshake failures impacting a subset of requests in EU-West. Mitigation in progress (traffic rebalancing)." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260314-1145

ben (net-eng): Found root cause candidate: one of the backend instances had an out-of-band OpenJDK update that tightened TLS ciphers earlier this morning (10:23 UTC). That host still had old cipher preferences and is failing clients negotiating certain suites. Rolling a patch to align TLS configs across the fleet.

sresteve: Patch deployed to 3 targets, healthchecks green. Error rate down to 2.1% in the last 5m. Latency normalizing.

alice (oncall): Starting a 30-min observation window. If stable, we'll de-escalate after 30m and close the page with RCA to follow.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation suppressed (ack by alice).

incident-bot: On-call handoff scheduled at 12:15Z — current oncall alice handing to chris (eu-night) due to overlap.

alice (oncall): Handoff: incident in mitigation, traffic partially shifted to eu-central, backend TLS configs patched to match fleet policy, error rate <3%. Chime me if regressions. Passing to @chris for overnight watch.

chris (eu-night): Acked. Taking over. Will monitor ALB target health+edge-proxy logs and wake team if error >5% or customer-impact increases.

support-lead: Customer comms update: sent targeted messages to 4 affected enterprise customers with remediation notes and offer of upgraded support window.

dana (platform): Post-incident actions: (1) add a preflight check for config drift on TLS policy after automated package updates, (2) add automation to validate cipher suites across fleet, (3) add an alert for sudden divergence in target TLS negotiation success rate.

alice (oncall): Thanks all. I'll draft RCA and link here in thread once complete. Closing page if metrics stable for observation window. :white_check_mark:

chris (eu-night): Observed for 35m, metrics stable. Closing incident in PagerDuty.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved in PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260314-1145 (resolved by chris)

alice (oncall): NOTE for postmortem: timeline, root cause = out-of-band JDK update causing cipher mismatch on one backend host; mitigation = traffic shift and config patch; preventive = config drift detection + automation. Assign action owners in next ops retro.

support-lead: I'll append customer notification logs to the incident doc.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents channel log."
